notes: Budgeted delivery E1, label-free retrieval freeze: Cell A (gbrain-shootout, hybridSearch at limit 40, unchanged) and Cell B (gbrain-query, one chunk-unit query at limit 25 per question, plus auto deliveries on a 3,500 to 8,000 budget grid for the sizing script, counts only). One VM per benchmark, so embeddings are paid once; the embedding cache is pulled back for the deliver cells. No reader or judge call.

cells.lease_basis: embeddings about $1.53 (21,821 x text-embedding-3-large), two retrieval policies with the Voyage reranker about $0.80, x1.5 and headroom
cells.command: export GBRAIN_EVALS_EMBED_CACHE="$SHOOTOUT_OUT/embed-cache" && bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark lme-s --limit 100 --seed 42 --system gbrain-shootout --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e1/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/cell-a" && bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark lme-s --limit 100 --seed 42 --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e1/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting stage=freeze --policy-setting grid=3500:8000:100 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/cell-b-freeze"
cells.setup_command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k,lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
